notes.title: Playdius becomes Dear Villagers, update your bookmarks!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31006285/5616d549bc6367e85662dd1d70eb4c4bb462f87d.jpg

Greetings everyone,

A few days ago we rebranded Playdius to Dear Villagers, as you can see here in our announcement trailer.
Considering we cannot rename this page we kindly invite you to keep following us on the new one: Dear Villagers on Steam.

Note that we also just announced two new very exciting games:

Recompile Explore the birth of sapient AI in this atmospheric hacking adventure set in the sprawling world of Recompile.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31006285/43b36fe8b6bffa19159e310a4e7348b1a6f72ef1.jpg

ScourgeBringer Fast-paced free-moving roguelite platformer. Help Kyhra to explore the unknown and to slash her way through the ancient machines guarding the seal of her past, and maybe the redemption of humanity.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31006285/4c9bb7e439a33240495493367775b090edfec980.gif

And not forgetting a new major update for the ongoing Early Access of JRPG Edge Of Eternity!!

Looking forward to fully release these games and unveil even new ones!

The Dear Villagers team

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Bug fixes, nerfs & a better Korean support
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/65cde3588f126dbf57afb61273d33bdff8fd7b11.png

Hi fellow pixel aficionados!

We're more than happy to see that you are more & more playing OSM & we've started fixing issues you've told us on social media. But let's get to the point, here's the patchlog of what changes in this new version!

- Nerfed visual effects for Outrash Revenge (glitches are not violent anymore)
- Better Korean support (font improved and changes in localization)
- [STEAM] Fixed achievements "All Star Teacher" and "All Star Newbie"
- Various bug fixes

Updates will continue to come, to stay up to date with the latest news and updates regarding Old School Musical, please visit the Official website, like the official  Facebook page and follow the game on Twitter.

And you can also add the game to your wishlist too!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/ae9abddd471fe04507c669938a0046b9527e493a.png
